newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Skanska says to lead U.S. construction project.
newsitem.headline: Skanska says to lead U.S. construction project.

text.p: Swedish construction company Skanska said on Thursday its U.S. subsidiary Sordoni Skanska was to be the contract manager for the construction of a nature and amusement park in Connecticut.
The total order value is close to two billion crowns, Skanska said in a statement.
The statement did not say how big Sordoni Skanska's share of the deal would be.
Skanska said the contract was awarded by the Six Flags amusement park chain, which owns a dozen theme parks in the United States.
Sordoni Skanska, which has its head office in New Jersey, provides customised solutions to clients in the retail, pharmaceuticals, health and medical care and educational sectors.
